correctness.rationale: For any ordered pair the rank-one Hintikka type consists exactly of its five atomic bits and a set of third-vertex five-bit patterns, and nesting these types yields all rank-three sentences. Symbolic cycle locality replaces lengths above seven by seven and multiplicities above three by three for every nonempty finite bijection structure, without increasing size. The standalone exact checker enumerates 16,383 canonical vectors, obtains 143 signatures, computes the minimum 19-point cover and proves sharpness using the reduction. An independent direct triple enumerator reproduces 731 small cases plus 509 further cases. Finite tests do not replace the infinite symbolic reduction.

value.rationale: Exact 143 realizable depth-three semantic classes and the sharp 19-point finite testbed are natural precise invariants of finite bijective successor relations. Multiplicities and interactions among cycle lengths are not determined by single-cycle thresholds, while the uniform minimal representative bound is meaningful for exhaustive finite-model testing. The complete classification is not a trivial renamed standard theorem.
